title: Quick Gooey Polish Beef Casserole
description: A hearty, winey, and gooey Polish dish featuring roast beef and chilli bean paste that can be prepared in under an hour.
instructions: Season the beef roast with salt and black pepper.
In a large Dutch oven or oven-safe pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Sear the beef roast until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the caraway seeds and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chilli bean paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the red wine and beef broth, scraping the bottom of the pan to release the browned bits.
Add the sliced mushrooms and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and roast for 45 minutes, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Slice the beef against the grain and return it to the pot.
